coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the fan on low for white noise, phone on silent to protect rest
Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and changing into clean clothes for the day
Making and eating a flexitarian breakfast of oats, toast and tea, then packing a lunch container and refilling a water bottle
Commuting by train and bus from Clayton to the Monash University campus, reading course notes on the way
Attending second-year Master of Social Work lectures and tutorials, taking detailed handwritten notes and writing down assignment deadlines
Eating the packed lunch on campus and reviewing notes for the afternoon placement shift
Commuting by bus and train to the aged-care facility for the afternoon support shift
Working a part-time aged-care support shift, assisting residents with meals, mobility, personal care and social activity programs
Commuting home by train and bus after the shift, checking text messages on the way
Reheating a simple flexitarian dinner, eating it and washing up the dishes and containers
Writing up placement reflections on the computer and updating the weekly budget notes and reminder list at the desk
Showering, washing up and setting out clothes and bag for the next day
Drinking a cup of tea and sending written text messages to housemates about the weekend house meeting agenda
Dimming the light, putting the phone on charge and settling into sleep with the fan on low
